text:
cs-lydia: Heads up — Customer HelioApp hitting sustained 502s + timeouts against hosted-inference in eu-central-1 since ~2026-03-15T08:12Z. They report ~40% error rate on generation calls and several auth retries. Customer is escalated, they need a status and repro steps.

oncall-bot: Alert triggered: hosted-api.eu-central-1 error-rate >30% (502/504) — incident id INC-20260315-ec1-01

sandeep: looking. can someone paste a curl sample from the customer? want to repro from our side.

cs-lydia: sample request they used: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -d '{"model":"gpt-small-1","input":"Hello"}'`

networking-sre: I ran traceroutes from our edge -> eu-central gateway and see multiple duplicate packets and high RTT variance across az2 -> az3 path. tcpdump snippet: `19:23:12.345678 IP 10.0.2.5 > 10.0.3.8: seq 1234 ack 0 (DF) (dup)`. Looks like microbursts/dup causing gateway timeouts.

dan: checked peering graphs — there were a few BGP withdraws from ProviderX around 08:10-08:18Z for AS64500 that correlate with the customer window. Could be asymmetric routing. provider status page shows instability in that POP.

maria: can we fail customers in that AZ to eu-west while provider investigates? need quick mitigation to restore SLAs. Also rolling back heavy batching might help reduce in-flight tokens.

jessica: note: customer reported many auth retries. retries + duplicated packets increase tail latency massively and spike billing because of duplicate tokens. we should recommend client backoff + idempotency key for now.

support-ops: reproduced from within our VPC using the provided curl — see repeated 502s and long connect times. Full curl output: ```HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\nConnection: close\nX-Request-Id: r-1a2b3c```

sandeep: proposed mitigation steps: 1) add temporary routing policy to steer traffic for hosted-inference eu-central-1 away from ProviderX POP (fail to eu-west-1); 2) enable model fallback to smaller replicate model in the same route to reduce tail latency; 3) pause aggressive client retries in edge LB.

networking-sre: opened provider ticket with ProviderX — ticket #PX-99231. Shared pcap + traceroute. ProviderX acknowledging packet duplication in their transit between eu-central-az2 and their transit fabric. They say investigating an internal pump on one circuit.

dan: I'll implement a route override in the smart-router for affected customer prefix and service plan (canary 10% then 100%). Planning change at 09:05Z.

maria: on it — created canary: `router set-weight hosted-inference eu-central-1 -> eu-west-1 10% --tag canary-px-99231` and reduced default batching from 64 -> 16 for canary. Deploy ID: deploy-7682.

oncall-bot: Deploy started: deploy-7682 by maria — canary weight 10% (hosted-inference routing).

support-ops: canary observations at +5m: error-rate for canary down to ~4%, latency p50 improved. non-canary still ~38% 502.

jessica: confirming auth failures are client-facing retries rather than token service. Looks like retries triggered by 502s — recommend notification to customers to add jittered exponential backoff and idempotency keys. sending customer note now.

networking-sre: ProviderX reports they've isolated the noisy circuit and are applying egress shaping patches. ETA 90 mins for full remediation. Asking if we can keep the canary failover until then.

dan: increasing canary to 60% now; if metrics hold will push 100% in 10m.

maria: canary -> 60% applied. Deploy log: `2026-03-15T09:18Z router weight update succeeded`

cs-lydia: told HelioApp support team we have a temporary routing change and they should see improvement. they asked for repro steps to validate on their side — shared `curl` with `--resolve` to point at eu-west LB and compare.

support-ops: final note — tracked a billing anomaly: duplicate requests from retries created token accounting spikes for a subset of customers. Finance flagged for billing adjustments. Filed FIN-2345 to reconcile.

networking-sre: will keep monitoring with ProviderX. capturing additional pcaps and will attach to PX-99231.

cs-lydia: wrapping up — customer confirmed degraded but improving. scheduling postmortem with involved teams and will hand off to eng-incident for RCA timeline. :white_check_mark:
